# Test fixtures (generated by mabench)

Generated by `scripts/regen-fixtures.sh` at the repository root, which also lists the exact commands.
`mabench/tests/test_fixtures.py` regenerates them in a temporary directory and requires every frame file to be
byte-identical to these, so the Python and Scala sides of the repository cannot drift apart. Regenerate only
after a deliberate change to the tile store format or the oracle.
